description: Resiliencia y adaptación: inclusión en preparación para emergencias en Puerto Rico tras el huracán María is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by El Fideicomiso de Salud Pública de Puerto Rico; CDC National Center for Environmental Health, Climate and Health Program. Al actualizar los planes de resiliencia durante su recuperación del huracán María, los puertorriqueños reconocieron la oportunidad de ser más inclusivos con las personas sordas o con problemas de audición. Coverage: the United States (2024). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
